summary: Writer ODT File commands preserve the LibreOffice-shaped SwDocShell/filter boundary and satisfy the approved browser integration scope.
findings: New, atomic Open ODT, and Save as ODT are implemented in the pinned menu/toolbar placements; local and text actions remain explicit, all planned success and failure paths are tested, both coverage suites are 100 percent, Chromium round-trips text and formatting, and parity reports zero evidence exceptions.
residual_risks: Browser Save As cannot retain an in-place filesystem handle, and unsupported ODF model entities remain explicit failures as documented.
